description.zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码。
description.en: The code of the flow. You can find the flow code in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

descriptions.zh:
- 在调用此接口前，请确保您的流程已创建流程日志设置。

- 若您的流程未创建流程日志设置，请先通过[CreateChatFlowLogSetting](~~2937211~~)接口创建流程日志设置。

- 您可通过此接口返回设置的唯一ID，调用[UpdateChatFlowLogSetting](~~2937210~~)接口更新流程日志设置。
descriptions.en:
- Before you call this operation, ensure that log settings are configured for the flow.

- If log settings are not configured for the flow, call the [CreateChatFlowLogSetting](~~2937211~~) operation to configure them.

- You can use the unique ID returned by this operation to call the [UpdateChatFlowLogSetting](~~2937210~~) operation to update the log settings.
